1: Nijanga cheppalante,growing up anedi manam chinnappudu imagine chesinattu simplega undadu.Chinnappudu peddavallu avvali ani chala excitedga undevallam.Endukante adult life ante freedom anipinchedi.Eppudu padukovalo,ekkadiki vellalo,em cheyalo maname decide chesukovachu anukunevallam.Kaani age perigina tarvata artham avuthundi,freedom tho paatu responsibilities kuda vastayani.Chinnappudu mana biggest problem homework complete cheyadam leda exam lo marks takkuva ravatam.Ippudu career gurinchi think cheyali,future gurinchi think cheyali,money gurinchi think cheyali,family gurinchi think cheyali.Konnisarlu manaki manam em kavalo kuda clear ga teliyadu.Ade growing up lo confusing part.Sometimes naaku childhood days chala miss avuthayi.Appudu life entha simplega undedo ippudu alochisthe artham avuthundi.Morning school ki velladam,evening friends tho aadukovadam,night homework complete chesi padukovadam.Antha simplega undedi.Oka new toy,oka favourite food,oka holiday leda birthday celebration...avi chalu.Happiness kosam chala pedda reasons avasaram undedi kaadu.Ippudu manaki chala things unnayi.Phone undi,internet undi,entertainment undi.Kaani mind peacefulga undatam sometimes difficult.Eppudu edo oka thought mind lo run avuthu untundi.Repu em cheyali?Future ela untundi?Job vastunda?Nenu correct direction lo unnaana?Ilaanti questions constantly untayi.Maybe growing up ante childhood ni completely vadileyadam kaadu.Childhood lo unna konni qualities ni manatho teesukellali.Appudu manam small things ki happy avvagaligam.Friends tho easyga connect ayyevallam.Mistake ayithe next day marchipoyevaram.Ippudu oka small mistake jarigina days varaku think chestham.Life serious ayina manam completely serious people avvakudadu.Responsibilities undali,future kosam prepare avvali.Kaani madhyalo fun kuda undali.Friends tho laugh cheyali.Family tho time spend cheyali.Favourite music vinvali.Randomga walk ki vellali.Konchem sillyga behave cheyadaniki kuda space undali.Endukante one day manam venakki chusi mana life ni remember chesukuntam.Appudu manam entha money earn chesam anedi okkate gurthu undadu.Mana memories gurthu untayi.Mana friends tho spend chesina time,mana family tho unna moments,mana failures,mana small victories...ive gurthu untayi.Anduke growing up ante childhood ni lose avvadam kaadu.Childhood lo unna happiness ni adult life lo kuda maintain cheyadam nerchukovadam ani nenu anukuntunnanu.
2: Naaku life lo biggest confusion career gurinchi anipisthundi.Chinnappudu future lo em avvali ani adigithe easyga answer cheppevallam.Doctor avvali,engineer avvali,police avvali ani edo okati cheppevallam.Appudu aa answer correct aa wrong aa ani think cheyalsina avasaram undedi kaadu.Kaani college ki vachina tarvata situation completely change ayipoyindi.Ippudu career ante just oka job kaadu.Job vachina tarvata salary entha?Growth ela untundi?Future securega untunda?Manaki interest untunda?Work pressure ela untundi?Ila chala questions vastayi.Inka biggest problem comparison.Evaraina mana age lo success ayithe,manaki immediatega oka thought vastundi.Nenu enduku ila unna?Nenu enduku inka achieve cheyaledu?Evaraina internship chesthe manam tension padatham.Evaraina job crack chesthe manam mana preparation gurinchi doubt chestham.Kaani recentga oka thing realize ayyanu.Everyone has a different starting point.Konthamandiki right guidance earlyga dorukutundi.Konthamandiki opportunities ekkuvaga vastayi.Konthamandiki financial support untundi.Inkonthamandi everything selfga figure out cheskovali.Anduke two people ni directga compare cheyadam correct kaadu.Sometimes manam behind unnattu anipisthundi.Kaani behind ante exactly emiti?Evaru decide chesaru manam ee age ki ee position lo undali ani?Life ki universal timetable emaina unda?Twenty-two ki job ravali,twenty-five ki settle avvali ani rules evaru create chesaru?Nenu ippudu aa pressure ni konchem reduce cheskovali anukuntunnanu.Naaku immediatega entire future teliyalsina avasaram ledu.Ippudu naaku next step teliste chalu.Ee roju oka skill improve cheyali.Repu oka problem solve cheyali.Ala slowly move avvali.Success ante always first place lo undadam kaadu.Mana own journey lo continue avvadam.Konni days fastga move avutham.Konni days slowga move avutham.Konni days completega stop ayipotham.Kaani stop ayina tarvata malli start cheyagaligite adhe important. Naaku ippatiki career gurinchi fear undi.Clarity kuda completega ledu.Kaani oka vishayam clearga telusu.Nenu vere vallani chusi naa journey ni judge cheyakudadu.Naa speed naadi.Naa path naadi.Maybe nenu konchem latega reach avvachu.Kaani reach ayina place naaku meaningfulga unte,chalu.
